description: This file defines the CellDataValidation class, which provides static methods for mapping DataValidation properties (type, error style, operator) to their corresponding internal representation codes in XLS file writing within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: CellDataValidation
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for translating DataValidation properties into internal XLS codes.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the internal code representing the DataValidation type based on its string value.

methods.name: errorStyle
methods.description: Returns the internal code for the DataValidation error style.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the internal code for the DataValidation operator.
